pages.title: Sublimation Chamber
pages.text: The Sublimation Chamber turns a batch of metal into a timed area effect. Right-click the top with the required metal blocks and a side with furnace fuel. The selected effect, remaining metal, fuel, and active time are shown near the crosshair while

A batch starts only when its required amount is present. It keeps its stored effect and timer after starting; running out of fuel pauses the clock and removes its active aura. The chamber's visible vapor follows the active effect's color.
Different metals provide different effects and durations. The following pages list the supplied batches. Recipe packs may replace them; a recipe viewer shows the current selection.

pages.title: Adamantine Block Batch
pages.text: 3 Adamantine Block supplies Health Boost I for 900 seconds per batch. The chamber applies level I auras, following its original behavior. Current server recipes take priority.
